note: What the replay harness (operating/autopilot_replay.py) counts as a person's real next action. A provider lists actions (person, time, workflow, the conversation, recipients and records they touched). 'record_actor' reads every store event that names a person as its actor (qualifier 'actor'): per-person activity in BC, the Portal, Sage and FileMaker counts as it lands, with no change here. 'plugins' adds a provider registered by name in operating/autopilot_replay.PLUGINS; an unknown provider refuses the whole file. 'feed_lag_minutes': per record type, how long after its time the live feed first holds it (the MC capture reads tasks about every 90 minutes, measured 2026-11: median 70, p75 132 minutes from an event to its capture); a decision before then was already taken when the feed saw the request, so the replay prepares nothing for it and judges an item from that time.
